title: Good memory foam pillow - average in performance
text: Good memory foam pillow - average in performance. I am a side sleeper and typically buy pillows from Macys which are relatively high priced for my support and needs ($100+). When I saw this pillow in Vine I snatched it up thinking it could be a good, lower-priced alternative for me. I will say that the support is decent, but not like the higher priced pillows I am used to purchasing. I also don't really understand the purpose of the shape and find it a tad awkward, particularly when trying to put it in a pillow case. Anyway, it is good as a pillow but I don't think if I had to buy it I would. I have since stopped using it and have placed it in the linen closet figure it will be good for an extra pillow if I need one. A little disappointed, but overall it held it's shape and did give support. I wouldn't recommend it for heavy duty side sleepers. I guess you get what you pay for.

product_metadata.title: Sleep Innovations VERSACURVE Memory Foam Pillow, Made in The USA with a 5-Year Warranty
features: THERAPEUTIC PILLOW: Drift into a sounder, deeper sleep on this neck pillow ideal for side, back and stomach sleepers.

CURVED SHAPE: The softly curved shape ensures gentle, therapeutic support for the shoulders of side sleepers and the neck of back sleepers, while having a low, comfortable profile for stomach sleepers.
MEMORY FOAM: The memory foam always holds its shape to gently align your head and neck to help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer.
COMFORT & SUPPORT: The gently curved silhouette makes this pillow perfect for those who change positions throughout the night, resulting in less tossing and turning and more deep sleep.
MADE IN THE USA: This Sleep Innovations therapeutic pillow is proudly made in the USA, always holds its shape and comes with a 5-year limited warranty.
